_comment: Effect lines from the bill body (v389). The v388 coverage pass left 106 pairs silent. 31 of them were silent only because the stored text was too thin: Highlighted Provisions that only “amend”, “modify” or “clarify” (30 Utah pairs), or a stored rationale that states an aim (H.R. 3633’s econ_growth row). Each was read one layer deeper: the Utah bill’s own text at `textFrom` (enrolled where it exists, else its last version), or the federal House-passed text. In `textQuote`, `[-…-]` marks text the bill struck and `[+…+]` text it inserted; only a change the bill makes supports a line, never existing law it reprints. Every phrase in `terms` is in those quotes and in the line; every other content word is in the provisions, quotes or title, in a `plain` restatement of a phrase they hold, or one of a few effect verbs; every qualifier in `bounds` stays in the line. Tense follows the Legislature’s record (`enactedPer`) or, federal, the act’s sibling lines. A pair whose body still states no clear change on its issue stays silent with `why`. The other 75 silent pairs (`notReopened`) are silent for a stronger reason — a sibling line, no bearing on the issue, an earlier pass that already read the bill body, a status conflict, a confirmation, or no vote row — and were not reopened. Lines are stored once in consistency.js _DOS_EFFECT under the EFFECT BODY TEXT SLICE 18 marker. No score, weight, mapping or key is read from or written to here.
